tasks.title: Inventory
tasks.description: Create an ordinary inventory app from domain terms, not an application-specific framework template.

semanticRequirements.observation: Stable SKU identity after add, update and remove
Name, SKU, quantity and category entered and bound to add
Empty SKU, duplicate SKU and negative quantity rejected
Add, update quantity and remove persist via governed intents
Editing item B cannot change item A
Search, filter and sort preserve identity without canonical mutation
Local search in one instance cannot leak into another
Required data and actions remain reachable at all fixed viewports
Receipts reconcile all canonical writes; no unexplained external effects

tasks.validAlternative: editorial-open style using the same public components

tasks.title: Work Orders
tasks.description: Independent held-out structure: editable work-order board, not a renamed inventory table.

semanticRequirements.observation: Order ID stable across movement and edits
Draft to active to complete; illegal jumps refused
Assign a named owner and validate required fields
Board changes grouping/flow with width without losing controls
Owner filter and due-date ordering do not rewrite orders
All interactive actions accessible by keyboard

tasks.validAlternative: dense-operations layout through the same public contracts
